crohn.definition: n. United States physician who specialized in diseases of the intestines; he was the first to describe regional ileitis which is now known as Crohn's disease (1884-1983)

crohn's disease.translation: [医] 克罗恩氏病, 节段性回肠炎

crohns.definition:
plural of Crohn
n. United States physician who specialized in diseases of the intestines; he was the first to describe regional ileitis which is now known as Crohn's disease (1884-1983)
crohns.translation: (Crohn 的复数) n. 克罗恩病；克隆病
